story_type: pararescuemen parachute into the open ocean to reach a sick baby on a sailboat far offshore
hook: They jumped into the open ocean to reach a sick baby.
narration: These men jumped into the open ocean to reach a sick one-year-old.
She was on a small sailboat with her family, nine hundred miles off Mexico.
Pararescuemen are paramedics who parachute, and four of them went out the back of the plane.
outcome: Three days later, a Navy frigate took the family and all four jumpers aboard.
title: Jumped into the ocean for a sick baby
description:
On April 3, 2014, four pararescuemen from the California Air National Guard's 129th Rescue Wing parachuted from an MC-130P about 900 nautical miles off Mexico to reach a seriously ill 1-year-old aboard the sailboat Rebel Heart. The frigate USS Vandegrift later brought the family and the four pararescuemen aboard.

Footage: U.S. Air National Guard video by Airman 1st Class Julia Bates, 129th Rescue Wing, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/327601/four-pararescuemen-parachute-out-over-mexico-waters-perform-rescue-capabilities
